name: London Biggin Hill Airport

runway.v: runway 03/21, 1,806 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: open 06:30 to 23:00 on weekdays and 08:00 to 22:00 at weekends and on public holidays

curfew.v: closed outside 06:30-23:00 on weekdays and 08:00-22:00 at weekends and on public holidays
curfew.quote: Monday - Friday 06:30 - 23:00 ... Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 08:00 - 22:00

ppr.v: all movements without a flight plan must be pre-notified to air traffic control
ppr.quote: introducing a requirement for all non-flight planned aircraft movements to be pre-notified to Air Traffic Control

handling.v: two full-service FBOs; the airport names Biggin Hill Exec
handling.quote: London Biggin Hill has two full service FBOs catering to every want and need for the business aviation user.

max_aircraft.v: pavement strength PCN 45/F/C/X/U; fire cover category 6 (no weight limit stated)

noise.v: jets must be ICAO Chapter 3 or better; only Chapter 4 aircraft 06:30-07:00; IFR jet departures follow the noise preferential route at no more than 185 knots
noise.quote: We restrict the period between 06:30 and 07:00 hours to Chapter 4 certified aircraft
